agency.name: Department of Workers' Claims (Education and Labor Cabinet)

ttd.basisLabel: Gross average weekly wage before taxes
ttd.rateText: 66-2/3% of the employee's average weekly wage, not more than 110% and not less than 20% of the state average weekly wage (KRS 342.730(1)(a))
ttd.minText: Statutory floor of 20% of the state average weekly wage (KRS 342.730(1)(a)); the 2026 schedule lists $232.36 as the minimum for temporary and permanent total disability.

waiting.text: No income benefits are payable for the first 7 days of disability unless disability continues for more than two weeks, in which case benefits are allowed from the first day (KRS 342.040(1)).

ttdDuration.text: No fixed week cap for TTD; all income benefits terminate when the employee reaches age 70 or four years after the injury or last exposure, whichever occurs last (KRS 342.730(4)).

ppd.text: PPD = 66-2/3% of AWW (capped at 82.5% of the state AWW; $958.49 for 2026 injuries) x AMA impairment rating x a statutory factor (0.65 for 0-5% up to 1.70 for 36%+); tripled if the worker cannot return to the same type of work (cap 110% of state AWW). Paid for 425 weeks if the rating is 50% or less, 520 weeks if above 50% (KRS 342.730(1)(b)-(d)). No minimum weekly PPD benefit.

facts.text: The 2026 maximum and minimum are based on Kentucky's 2024 state average weekly wage of $1,161.81, certified under KRS 342.143 (Department of Workers' Claims memo dated September 2, 2025).
Overdue income benefits carry 6% annual interest, raised to 12% if an ALJ finds the denial, delay or termination was without reasonable foundation (KRS 342.040(1)).
Income benefits must start no later than the fifteenth day after the employer has knowledge of the disability, and be paid at least semimonthly (KRS 342.040(1)).

Kentucky adds age and education factors to the PPD multiplier: +0.6 if 60 or older, +0.4 if 55 or older, +0.2 if 50 or older; +0.4 for under 8 years of schooling, +0.2 for under 12 years (KRS 342.730(1)(c)3).
The 2026 lump-sum death benefit is $114,120.35 (KRS 342.750(6), 2026 benefit schedule).
